_contract: Derived budget for R0, the reference calibration and D2 (search + behaviour on d_series_shared_eval@v1). AUTHORIZES NOTHING; each paid step needs its own grant at the live rate.
k_status: K=4 PREPARED per the independent review; frozen only in D2's preregistration

reference_calibration.steps_are: deadline-gated: the calibration record is written first; a step starts only when the driver's deadline covers its whole bound, and an extended step also the core bounds still to come. The session cap prices the must-complete work plus the two CORE steps at their bounds; the extended steps (the cached-vs-recomputed and D2 scored-rows equivalences) run inside the same cap whenever earlier work beats its bound (expected: always)
reference_calibration._basis: setup from R0's plan (measured a2/a8 components); B rebuild measured 1279.8 s (expected) and D1's 22 min per arm (bound); forwards from state-evaluation timings (80 items in ~11 s at the frozen suite) with a 5x allowance

measured_basis.source: logs/stages/stage-1/phase_d1/runs/d1_search_20261006_210210/closeout/outcome.json: 92/92 expansions, same space, support, beam and L40S

objective_overhead.source: measured once: logs/stages/stage-1/families/d_series/validations/d2-gpu-validation/v1/runs/d2val_20261014_103301/out/adoption_all_v1/adoption.json (Stage V, adopted); the bound adds a variation margin

operator_cell_factor.what: the weighted activation statistics: Stage V's full- over narrow-scope operator seconds

one_time_minutes.what: root reference store builds, one per calibration profile

rescoring._timing_only: B's initialization stands in for a trained student of the same size; no behavioural quantity is measured here

cache_fix.what: `_available_memory_bytes` returns the allocator's hoard (empty_cache) before reading the driver: D1's search recomputed the reference in 15/16 DEPTH expansions with 0.12 GiB free and 36 GiB reclaimable
cache_fix._validated_on_gpu_is: DERIVED from the booked, hash-verified stage-L evidence above; never set by hand
cache_fix.validated_by: stage L's DEPTH pair, which runs under a deliberately hoarded pool and records reference_cache.mode; or D2's own first DEPTH expansions
cache_fix.until_validated: the planning bound prices DEPTH at D1's measured recompute-mode maxima

previous_model_superseded.why: D1's design priced DEPTH from a8's one CACHED invocation (1194 s); D1's own search then recomputed the reference cache in 15 of 16 DEPTH expansions, up to 2486 s. The records model takes DEPTH from that search, and applies the objective's overhead to the two paths it touches instead of x1.10 on every structural minute

assumptions_not_measured: EVERY added term of the redesigned D2 (contract revision 6): c_T x KL in DEPTH and state evaluation at +5% (expected) / +10% (bound) of D1's paths; the round-0 parent-KL diagnostic at {'expected': 0.5, 'bound': 1.0} of D1's per-candidate reduction; the weighted statistics at +5% / +10% of the FFN/WIDTH/ATTENTION cells; the root stores at {'expected': 2.0, 'bound': 5.0} DEPTH-candidate evaluations per profile. Stage L's objective timing measured the SUPERSEDED objective and is not used here; the D2 GPU validation measures these before the search is priced from them
D2's trajectory has D1's size (92 expansions, 16 DEPTH): the beam schedule fixes the expansion count, not the operator mix

the reference cache fix (validated by stage L for D1's parent reference) also holds the redesigned DEPTH, whose parent reference is now the round-0 diagnostic and whose root reference is a resident store; the driver's cache guard still stops the search on the first recomputing expansion
d2_search.hard_is: a PLANNING BOUND from D1's measured maxima, not a proven bound on runtime. What bounds MONEY is the enforceable stop below; the bound decides only whether the search is expected to FINISH inside it

enforceable_stop.set_at: the D2 search authorization, at the live rate
enforceable_stop.mechanism: the launcher's session cap: the watchdog kills the pod at the plan's hard-terminate minutes and the driver's soft stop fails the search closed before it, so spend stops at the cap whatever the runtime

d2_search._basis: expected = D1's measured 551.99 min + the redesigned objective's expected added minutes over D1's trajectory; bound = D1's search_cost on the records-rebuilt cost model plus the one-time root stores

objective_overhead.source: measured once: logs/stages/stage-1/families/d_series/validations/reference-calibration/v1/runs/refcal_20261013_170714/out/adoption_all_v1/adoption.json (stage L); the bound adds a variation margin

d3_search_for_programme_view._basis: D3 does the student Top-K entropy work stage L measured on the superseded D2; priced with that measurement and its one-measurement margin

totals.rescoring: MEASURED by stage L and inside the behavioural ceilings with the one-measurement margin
